verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, and a sandbox or test environment for developers or agents is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of a sandbox, test mode, developer API environment, or any isolation from live account data. The cited material covers only consumer banking features (accounts, cards, invoicing, integrations), so absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
